Callout.Name: Armoured Truck Intercepted
Callout.Message: Armoured truck stopped in the road, crew not responding.

Script.Line: The crew are not answering the radio and the engine is still running.
There are two in the front and I have not seen either of them move.
The back door has been worked on. I can see the marks from here.

Lines.Approach: The truck is stopped and nobody is answering from it. Approach like they are still inside.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
